title: Nutrition tubes — the image, and the build
question: First card: the frosted-glass image you chose. Next two: the widget built into the app, with three sample meals on this computer's test copy only. Approve it, or say what is still off.

options.label: Chosen image
options.thesis: Frosted capsules on a soft lavender-peach light.

options.label: Built: the tubes
options.thesis: The same frosted capsules in the app, one glowing colour per tube, a fine white line between meals.
options.viewport: The app's own colours for calories, protein, carbs, fat - violet, coral, green, gold - so the rest of the screen still matches.
options.risk: The image used amber for calories and blue for fat; the build keeps the app's colours so the numbers below and elsewhere agree.

options.label: Built: with the title
options.thesis: The card's top: title set large at the start, like the image.
options.viewport: The starting-target note shows only until the profile is filled in.
options.risk: The screen around the card (header, tabs) is not restyled yet.
